```json
{"type":"fix","title":"fix(docfix-poll): end nightly re-alerts for zero-commit wedged branches","commit_subject":"fix(docfix-poll): reap clean zero-own-commit wedged branches directly","summary_md":"## Summary\n- A run that died before its first commit left a clean branch with no own commits. `bin/cleanup` skipped it as "not merged", so `salvage_wedged_branch` could never reap it, and the poll re-alerted every night.\n- In the clean-tree path: if the branch tip is an ancestor of `origin/master` (nothing unique to lose), call `wt-remove --force --volumes` and `git branch -D` directly instead of leaving it.\n- In the salvage-push path: after `bin/cleanup` returns, check whether the ref is still live with `show-ref --verify` and remove it ourselves when cleanup skips it, so the branch can't re-wedge the next night.\n- Adds a `wt-remove` shim to the test sandbox and three new cases (23a/b/c): clean ancestor is removed, clean branch with own commits is left alone, dirty salvaged branch is removed after a successful push."}
```
